searchLedger.hypothesis: An edited path or skill name reaches a shell through the router's checker dispatch.

searchActions.result: spawnSync with argv arrays; no shell; skill name is one path segment

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: argv-array spawn sites with no shell and no string command lines
searchLedger.rationale: New attacker-influenced input is a directory name passed as one argv element.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Unquoted expansion in the wrapper lets the edited path inject shell syntax.

searchActions.result: all expansions quoted; exec node <script> gate "$@"; no eval

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: quoted exec with no dynamic command construction
searchLedger.rationale: The wrapper is 12 lines and every expansion is quoted.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A versioning pass writes outside the skills root for a stray manifest or paths entry.

searchActions.result: fail-closed root guard returns skip-out-of-root; discovery admits real files only

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: lexical containment guard plus non-symlink discovery; explicit-symlink case is pre-existing and operator-supplied
searchLedger.rationale: No path in this change set strengthens or weakens the guard.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The backtick scanner reads or executes doc-authored paths outside the listed bases.

searchActions.result: existsSync only; hits are silent; absolute/~ /scheme/placeholder/glob/runtime-output tokens skipped

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: existence probe with no read/exec/write, and a hit produces no output
searchLedger.rationale: Output records non-resolution only, so it is not a usable existence oracle.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The widened two-column check probes outside the repository or passes cell text to git/ shell.

searchActions.result: outside-root candidates classify missing before git; git runs via argv lists with --

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: containment check precedes any git call and no shell is used
searchLedger.rationale: The widening changes row selection, not probing capability.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Doc text builds a RegExp or triggers catastrophic backtracking in the new checks.

searchActions.result: exact Set membership; fixed linear regexes only

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no dynamic RegExp construction; patterns are fixed and linear
searchLedger.rationale: Token comparison is exact, not pattern-based.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Runtime/scripts citation bases open untracked or out-of-tree files.

searchActions.result: candidates resolve only when tracked; window reads follow resolveTracked results

searchLedger.rationale: The new bases append candidates; only tracked paths are ever opened.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Removing a SKILL.md frontmatter block makes the version gate pass.

searchActions.result: skip-no-frontmatter reported as a skip; documented in the standard

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: documented contract, reported as skip rather than ok, unchanged by this change set
searchLedger.rationale: The rewritten standard retains the skip rule for the narrowed SKILL.md-only scope.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The 2,845-file strip altered content beyond the version line.

searchActions.result: 2845 files, 0 additions, 2845 deletions; 0 removed lines without version:; no mode changes or symlinks

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: one removed line per file, all version lines, no additions
searchLedger.rationale: Git arithmetic over the strip commit bounds the mutation to the version line.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The bump commit ships a stale effectivePolicyHash pin.

searchActions.result: route hash compared against the selected pin at serve time; pins updated in all live copies

searchLedger.deferredReason: recomputation needs the compiled-routing tooling; runtime comparison verified instead
searchLedger.rationale: Not scored; deferred to the compiled-routing test suite.
